verdict.rationale: Navan's in-product AI assistant Ava is described as analyzing real-time spend data, summarizing by month and category, comparing spend to policy, predicting future spend, and proactively suggesting savings (docs-17 through docs-20, docs-31). The data-driven 'price to beat' hotel target adds an in-product suggestion based on location, date, and demand (docs-12). The MCP evidence covers querying through external AI tools, not insights inside the product, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond a launch blog post, details on how and where Ava surfaces proactive insights, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the insights work as claimed.
